verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers AI-driven categorization, AI Close, and automated bookkeeping features that run in the background, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose automation/agent framework the user can configure to trigger arbitrary autonomous workflows; it's limited to accounting-specific tasks. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger configuration UI, evidence of user-defined autonomous multi-step automations beyond categorization/close, independent verification of unattended operation.
